경영진은 생산 환경의 에이전틱 AI 사용량이 연초 이후 전년 대비 13배 이상 늘었고, Q3에 500만 달러 초과 신규 ACV 계약 19건을 체결했다고 밝혔다.
투자·효율 측면에서 자본지출을 줄이는 자본효율적 모델을 강조하며, 연간 잉여현금흐름 마진 목표를 100bp 높여 36%로 제시했다.
가이던스 설명에서 회사는 2026년 비GAAP 영업이익률 31.5%, 구독 총이익률 81%를 제시했고, CEO는 AI·보안·기술부채를 통합 관리하는 ‘Control Tower’ 전략이 고객의 채택을 가속한다고 강조했다.
공개된 회사 실적자료에는 컨퍼런스콜 질의응답의 구체적 문답이 확인되지 않아 Q&A 쟁점은 자료만으로 요약하지 않았다.

dropped.text: Q3 구독 매출은 39억8,800만 달러로 전년 대비 21% 늘었고, 비GAAP 영업이익률은 32.5%였다. 회사는 연간 구독 매출 가이던스를 157억8,000만~157억9,000만 달러로 제시했다.

points.text: 회사 자료는 분기 실적이 가이던스를 웃돌았고 연간 구독 매출·잉여현금흐름 전망을 상향했다고 밝혀, 가이던스 미달이 하락 원인이었다고 확인해 주지는 않습니다.
회사는 설비투자를 줄이고 잉여현금흐름 마진 전망을 높였다고 설명했습니다. 이 자료만으로는 마진, 현금흐름 또는 수요 우려가 주가 하락을 일으켰다고 단정할 수 없습니다.

briefs.checkText: Document Meta Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results Announces Establishment of New Class C Common Stock MENLO PARK, Calif. - October 21, 2026 - Meta Platforms, Inc. (Nasdaq: META) today reported financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. "We hit major milestones this quarter toward delivering personal superintelligence for everyone - including launching Muse and Muse Wonder, our first frontier model," said Mark Zuckerberg, Meta founder and CEO. "Our investments are paying off, the core business is strong, and we're seeing velocity across the board." Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights Three Months Ended September 30, % Change In millions, except percentages and per share amounts 2026 2025 Revenue $ 64,601 $ 51,242 26 % Costs and expenses 51,613 30,707 68 % Income from operations $ 12,988 $ 20,535 (37) % Operating margin 20 % 40 % Provision for income taxes $ 3,141 $ 18,954 (83) % Effective tax rate 24 % 87 % Net income $ 9,860 $ 2,709 264 % Diluted earnings per share (EPS) $ 3.83 $ 1.05 265 % Agreement with U.S. State Attorneys General In August 2026, we announced an agreement with 52 attorneys general to resolve litigation related to teen mental health and social media, which provides for payments of up to approximately $18.59 billion. Third quarter 2026 costs and expenses includes a $9.89 billion charge related to this agreement. Excluding this charge, the third quarter 2026: • Income from operations of $12.99 billion would have increased by $9.89 billion to $22.88 billion. • Diluted EPS of $3.83 would have increased by $3.57 to $7.40. • Effective tax rate of 24% would have decreased by 7 percentage points to 17%. Third Quarter 2026 Operational and Other Financial Highlights • Family daily active people (DAP) - DAP was 3.64 billion on average for September 2026, an increase of 3% year-over-year. • Ad impressions - Ad impressions delivered across our Family of Apps increased by 10% year-over-year. • Average price per ad - Average price per ad increased by 14% year-over-year. • Revenue - Revenue was $64.60 billion, an increase of 26% year-over-year on both a reported and constant currency basis. • Costs and expenses - Total costs and expenses were $51.61 billion, an increase of 68% year-over-year. This includes the litigation charge as discussed above. • Capital expenditures - Capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, were $34.91 billion. • Capital return program - Dividend and dividend equivalent payments were $1.36 billion. • Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities - Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities were $82.45 billion as of September 30, 2026. • Cash flow - Cash flow from operating activities was $32.79 billion, and free cash flow was negative $2.12 billion. (1) • Headcount - Headcount was 66,775 as of September 30, 2026, a decrease of 15% year-over-year. ____________________________________ (1) For more information on our free cash flow non-GAAP financial measure, see the sections entitled "Non-GAAP Financial Measures" and "Reconciliation of GAAP to Non-GAAP Results" in this press release. 1 CFO Outlook Commentary We expect fourth quarter 2026 total revenue to be in the range of $73-76 billion. Our guidance assumes foreign currency is an approximately 1% headwind to year-over-year total revenue growth, based on current exchange rates. We are raising our expense outlook to incorporate the $9.9 billion charge related to legal proceedings recognized in the third quarter. We now expect full year 2026 total expenses to be in the range of $175-179 billion. Excluding the third quarter legal charge, we continue to expect 2026 operating income to be above 2025 operating income. At a segment level, we now expect Reality Labs losses to decline compared to 2025 to a range of $18-19 billion. We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $135-145 billion, narrowed from our prior outlook of $130-145 billion. Absent any changes to our tax landscape, we expect our fourth quarter 2026 tax rate to be between 15-17%. Additionally, we continue to monitor active legal and regulatory matters that could significantly impact our business and financial results. For example, we continue to see scrutiny on youth-related issues in several markets and have a number of youth-related trials scheduled in the coming months in the U.S. Looking beyond 2026, we are still developing our budget and capacity plans for next year, but we expect to continue investing aggressively to support both our core business and emerging AI initiatives. Our current capacity and what is scheduled to come online gives us the flexibility to allocate resources across model training, core business growth, and the development and support of new products. Our AI investments are already delivering substantial incremental advertising revenue through stronger engagement, better recommendations, and more efficient monetization. Building on this progress, our MSL investments are creating the technology and infrastructure needed to unlock significant new revenue opportunities and strengthen capabilities across the business. While these investments will take longer to generate returns than those in our core business, the breadth of monetization opportunities and internal efficiencies gives us confidence in their long-term potential. Looking ahead, although we are not providing a full-year 2027 revenue outlook, the benefits our AI investments are delivering to the core business, combined with emerging opportunities from model advances and product launches, position us to sustain strong overall revenue growth throughout 2027. Separately, we remain focused on improving Reality Labs profitability and expect losses to narrow next year to around $15 billion as we reallocate investment toward other priority areas, primarily AI. 2 Establishment of New Class C Common Stock The Board of Directors has approved the establishment of a new class of publicly listed, non-voting Class C common stock, with an effective date in January 2027. The approval by Meta's Board follows the unanimous recommendation of a Special Committee of disinterested and independent directors, which was established by the Board to evaluate the company's capital structure. The Special Committee and the Board determined that creating this new class of stock is advisable, fair, and in the best interests of Meta and its shareholders for a number of reasons, including: • Creating a New Class of Shares for Capital Raising, Employee Compensation, Potential Acquisitions, and Other General Corporate Purposes - The scale of investment required to compete, sustain growth, expand infrastructure, and pursue new strategic initiatives amidst the AI transformation taking place in the industry is significant. The Special Committee determined this new class of common stock will provide Meta the ability to finance its growth and help the company remain a leader among fierce competition both domestic and international. • Continuing to Maximize Long-Term Value for All Shareholders - Since Meta's formation, its management team has prioritized long-term goals and value creation, and its stock price has increased by more than 1,700% since its IPO. By contrast, over the same period, the S&P 500 has increased approximately 495%. The Special Committee wants Meta to continue innovating with an emphasis on long-term growth, which the creation of the Class C stock is intended to help facilitate. • Ensuring Founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg Continues to Lead Meta into the Next Era - The Special Committee concluded that Mr. Zuckerberg is best suited to lead Meta into its next era and beyond. They recognized that Meta's track record of significant value creation for its shareholders is in large part due to his strong leadership, unique and creative vision, and exceptional management abilities. The creation of the Class C common stock will continue the founder-led model that has driven the company's success since its inception. Meta intends to file an amended and restated certificate of incorporation in Delaware to establish the Class C common stock, with an effective date of January 19, 2027. The Board has also declared a one-time stock dividend of one share of Class C common stock for each outstanding share of Class A common stock and Class B common stock, contingent upon, and to be paid after, the effectiveness of the amended and restated certificate of incorporation. The record date and payment date of the stock dividend will be determined by the Board at a later date. After the payment date of the stock dividend, we expect the market price for our Class A common stock to reflect the effect of a two-for-one stock split. The stock dividend will not change the voting power of any shareholder. The amended and restated certificate of incorporation has been approved by shareholder written consent. We have also entered into a Founder Alignment Agreement with Mr. Zuckerberg, which has terms related to his sales of Class C common stock received in the stock dividend, his service at the company, and conditions for potential future stock dividends of Class C common stock. Meta's Class A common stock will continue to trade on Nasdaq, and we intend to qualify the Class C common stock for listing on Nasdaq upon its issuance as a result of the stock dividend. More information will be available in our Report on Form 8-K and information statement to be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Moelis & Company LLC served as independent financial advisor to the Special Committee and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC served as financial advisor to Meta. 3 Webcast and Conference Call Information Meta will host a conference call to discuss its results at 1:30 p.m. PT / 4:30 p.m. ET today. The live webcast of the call can be accessed at the Meta Investor Relations website at investor.atmeta.com, along with the company's earnings press release, financial tables, and slide presentation. Transcripts of conference calls with publishing equity research analysts held today will also be posted to the investor.atmeta.com website.
